inputs.description: A single continuous horizontal dungeon standing-floor TOP SURFACE tile. 128x32 native pixel artwork, the ENTIRE rectangular canvas filled edge to edge by a flat walking plane of broad muted violet-gray stone slabs. This is the walking surface seen slightly from above for a 2D side-view battle, not a front wall. Three or four large shallow floor stones across, narrow quiet joints, subtle top-left stone edge lighting, almost no texture. One uninterrupted plane; horizontal seamless repeat. Match reference 1 purple dungeon floor MATERIAL but make its visible top surface deeper, analogous to reference 2 broad underwater floor. Retain purple gray stone, not teal. No raised steps, no stacked ledges, no front fascia, no vertical brick wall, no floating isolated block, no outline around canvas, no characters or props. Quiet broad clean planes for characters to stand on. Crisp Dungeon Matcher native pixel-art discipline, no blur or dithering.
